name: gongpo-donggung-pro
description: Evidence-separated archaeological viewer corpus for 경주 동궁과 월지 서편 A건물지 (Gyeongju Donggung & Wolji, West A-building site). Core product is evidence separation, not visual reconstruction.

scripts.goal: npm run goal:core && npm run goal:web
scripts.goal:web: npm run copy:web && npm run web:build
scripts.goal:strict: node scripts/build-artifacts.mjs --strict && node scripts/verify.mjs --strict && npm run test:core
scripts.m1: npm run validate && npm run derive && npm run verify && npm run corrupt && npm run test:core
scripts.m3: npm run reports && npm run forbidden
scripts.reports: node scripts/generate-evidence-report.mjs && node scripts/generate-hypotheses-report.mjs && node scripts/generate-phase-report.mjs && node scripts/generate-superstructure-proxy-report.mjs && node scripts/generate-license-audit.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:web-smoke
scripts.test:core: node tests/derive.test.mjs && node tests/verify.test.mjs && node tests/hypothesis.test.mjs && node tests/source-policy.test.mjs && node tests/corpus.test.mjs && node tests/source-segments.test.mjs && node tests/report2022-corpus.test.mjs && node tests/kim2023-h1.test.mjs && node tests/lee2023-hypothesis.test.mjs && node tests/ji2023-phase.test.mjs && node tests/no-public-pdf-assets.test.mjs && node tests/corruption.test.mjs && node tests/license.test.mjs && node tests/forbidden-language.test.mjs && node tests/superstructure-proxy.test.mjs && node tests/no-superstructure-overclaim.test.mjs && node tests/snapshot.test.mjs
scripts.test:web-smoke: node tests/web-routes.test.mjs && node tests/viewer-artifact-smoke.test.mjs && node tests/proxy-viewer-mode.test.mjs && node tests/e2e-smoke.test.mjs
